items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They had several of them. Not Vince Facturo, Louis Dumaine.

ctx.x: No. They grabbing that one meatball left. And I'm surprised. If I wouldn't have reached for that, but I wouldn't have got that one meatball. So I come back. I was telling my brother Clarence about it. He said, look, next time you get out there, you reach. When they reach, you reach with both hands. See, because that's the way they're all. They'll eat up everything you install. Yeah. Yeah. But I learned a lot from those fellas, you know. Old Tom Copen, another bass player. I've been trying to think of him. I…
They had several of them. Not Vince Facturo, Louis Dumaine.

That was before Louis Dumaine. Louis Dumaine was the... Martin Martinez. Yeah, yeah, him, Martinez. Joe Martinez. Yeah, he was an evil... The way he used to holler at them fellas, like if there was dogs, I heard him.
